correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the complete proof: Gram isometry iff degree 1..4 Walsh means vanish by symmetric differences; triangular Krawtchouk basis iff unbiased moments (0,n,0,3n²-2n). A monic cubic orthogonal to 1 and T gives exactly σ2=-(3n-2), σ3=-nσ1; degree-four exactness follows by polynomial division, weights uniquely from quadratic Lagrange interpolation. Strict positivity is proved by w_i=E[L_i(S)²]>0. The single-root discriminant loop is algebraically exhaustive with a²=n impossible. Pole/symmetric/interior and Pell identities check symbolically, and the first multi-orbit dimension 65 follows from the proven exhaustive integer algorithm on n4..64, executed and independently pair-enumerated. The submitted actual verify.py ran successfully with exact fractions on all n4..250 and independent 740 Walsh Gram entries, as recorded in verify_output.txt. Finite calculations are not mistaken for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The mathematical object is the entire degree≤2 Walsh character frame, and the invariant is exact positive isometric sampling on the smallest number of complete Hamming layers. The result gives all-dimension necessary/sufficient integer equations and unique positive weights, an effective O(n) candidate enumeration, a sharp three-shell minimum, complete pole and symmetry subfamilies, a genuinely interior infinite family, the exact first inversion-orbit branching dimension 65, and an infinite Pell coexistence family. These describe structural sampling-design possibilities and boundaries, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice or merely a routine formula. No general optimality among arbitrary point samplers is asserted.
